name: Nemotron-Research-Reasoning-Qwen-1.5B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A distillation of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.777 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence cc-by-nc-4.0, repo created 2025-05-28. CAVEATS: Distilled/RL-trained from DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, CC-BY-NC-4.0. Six rows all from the card's three result tables, gains are large (Reasoning Gym 4.24 -> 59.06). Note the card also publishes -v2 (61.69 avg) and -BroRL (63.66 avg) which beat this checkpoint; this record is the base release only.
